testSuite.name: TC04_DTIAbove50_ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC05_LTVExactly95_NotManual_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review, but rule 3 requires LTV <= 80, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVAbove95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds the threshold and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC07_FixedPreference_OverridesARMConditions
testSuite.description: All ARM conditions are met, but explicit fixed-rate preference gives priority to Fixed30 (rule 2 before rule 3).

testSuite.name: TC08_HighRateSensitivity_Fixed30
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is false but rate sensitivity is high, so Fixed30 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC09_MediumSensitivity_ARMBoundaries
testSuite.description: All boundary values for ARM 7/1 are met: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income.

testSuite.name: TC10_HorizonAboveSeven_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds seven years, so ARM 7/1 is not assigned and no product results.

testSuite.name: TC11_VariableIncome_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Income is variable, so rule 3 fails and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditBelow720_NoProductButNotManual
testSuite.description: Credit 719 is above 640 so no manual review, but below 720 so rule 3 fails and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVAbove80_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80 so ARM 7/1 is not assigned; LTV is below 95 so no manual review.

testSuite.name: TC14_NullFixedAndSensitivity_ARMApplies
testSuite.description: Null fixedPreference and rateSensitivity make rule 2 unmet; rule 3 conditions are all met, so ARM7/1 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC15_NullHorizon_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Null horizonYears makes rule 3 unmet and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScore_FixedPreferenceApplies
testSuite.description: Null creditScore makes the credit condition of rule 1 unmet, so rule 2 applies and gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_MultipleManualTriggers_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit below 640, DTI above 50 and LTV above 95 all hold; the result is ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullIncomeStability_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Null incomeStability makes rule 3 unmet and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullLTV_ARMUnmet_Ambiguous
testSuite.description: LTV is null, so rule 3 is unmet and rule 1 is not triggered by LTV. The schema says DMN may compute LTV from loan and appraisal, which the rules do not address.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 and 3 depend on LTV, which is null here. The rules state that a null-dependent condition is unmet, but the schema says DMN may derive LTV from loan amount and appraised value. If LTV were computed, rule 3 could apply (possible outputs: [] or ARM7/1).

testSuite.name: TC20_CreditBelow640_NoFixedNeeded_ManualReview

testSuite.name: ManualReview_CreditScore639_NullFixedPreference

          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income != null and application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 then ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(append(for d in application.debts return (if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0), 0)) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>

testSuite.name: TC01_ManualReview_CreditScore_639
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so rule 1 applies and overrides the explicit fixed-rate preference.

testSuite.name: TC02_Fixed30_CreditScore_640_Boundary
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review; explicit fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_Fixed30_DTI_50_Boundary
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not activate rule 1; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC04_ManualReview_DTI_50_1
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so manual review is required even with fixed preference.

testSuite.name: TC05_Fixed30_LTV_95_Boundary
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not activate rule 1; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReview_LTV_95_1
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95, so manual review applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_Fixed30_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: No explicit fixed preference but high rate sensitivity gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC08_ARM7_1_Boundary_All_Inclusive
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity, LTV 80, credit score 720, horizon 7 years is not checked here; values at inclusive boundaries give ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC09_ARM7_1_Horizon_7_Boundary
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years is inclusive for ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC10_NoProduct_Horizon_7_5
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM7/1 does not apply and no default product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC11_NoProduct_LTV_80_1
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80, so ARM7/1 does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC12_NoProduct_CreditScore_719
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is above manual threshold but below 720, so ARM7/1 does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC13_NoProduct_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM7/1 stability condition and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARM7_1_NullFixedPreferenceAndSensitivity
testSuite.description: Null fixed preference and null rate sensitivity are unmet conditions, so rule 2 does not apply and rule 3 gives ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC15_Fixed30_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes manual review condition unmet and ARM condition unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC16_NoProduct_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes ARM condition unmet and no fixed preference exists, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC17_Fixed30_NullDTI
testSuite.description: Null DTI makes manual review condition unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC18_NoProduct_NullLTV
testSuite.description: Null LTV makes the ARM7/1 LTV condition unmet; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC19_ManualReview_LowCreditScore_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Low credit score triggers manual review and takes precedence over high rate sensitivity.

testSuite.name: TC20_ManualReview_CreditScore_Zero
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640, so manual review applies.

testSuite.name: TC21_NoProduct_NullHorizon
testSuite.description: Null horizon makes the ARM7/1 horizon condition unmet and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC22_NoProduct_NullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Null income stability makes the ARM7/1 stability condition unmet.

testSuite.name: TC23_NoProduct_AllNullExceptId
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null, so no condition is met and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC24_ARM7_1_HorizonZero_Boundary
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years is within the 7-year limit and all other ARM7/1 conditions are met at boundaries.

testSuite.name: TC25_ManualReview_Overrides_ARM_Conditions
testSuite.description: Rule 1 is triggered by DTI above 50 even though all ARM7/1 conditions are met; manual review takes precedence.

testSuite.name: TC02_CreditScoreBoundary640

testSuite.name: TC03_DtiExactly50NotManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not activate manual review; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC04_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC05_LtvExactly95NotManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not activate manual review; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC06_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC07_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference with no manual review conditions gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC08_HighRateSensitivityGivesFixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference gives Fixed30 even though ARM conditions are met (rule 2 has priority over rule 3).

testSuite.name: TC09_ArmAllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720 and stable income all sit on inclusive boundaries, giving ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC10_HorizonJustAboveSeven

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvJustAboveEighty

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditScoreJustBelow720

testSuite.name: TC13_VariableIncomeNoArm

testSuite.name: TC14_NullCreditScoreArmNotMet

testSuite.name: TC15_NullFixedAndSensitivityArmApplies

testSuite.name: TC16_NullLtvArmNotMet

testSuite.name: TC17_NullDtiLowCreditManual

testSuite.name: TC18_AllNullNoProduct

testSuite.name: TC20_ArmMinimalValuesAccepted

testSuite.name: TC22_NoConditionsMetNoDefault

          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income = null or application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.housing = null then null else (sum(for k in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if k = null then 0 else k) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>

testSuite.name: Manual review low credit score 639
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so rule 1 applies and the application goes to manual review, even though fixed preference is set.

testSuite.name: Credit score 640 boundary not manual

testSuite.name: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: DTI just above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so rule 1 applies and the result is ManualReview.

testSuite.name: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review
testSuite.description: LTV equal to 95 does not activate rule 1; high rate sensitivity yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: LTV above 95 triggers manual review over fixed preference
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95, so rule 1 overrides the explicit fixed-rate preference.

testSuite.name: High rate sensitivity overrides ARM conditions
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity high yields Fixed30 by rule 2, which takes priority over rule 3 even though all ARM conditions are met.

testSuite.name: ARM all boundaries inclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720 and stable income meet inclusive ARM thresholds with no fixed preference.

testSuite.name: Horizon above 7 years blocks ARM
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so rule 3 does not apply and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: Credit score 719 blocks ARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so rule 3 is not met and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: LTV above 80 blocks ARM

testSuite.name: Variable income blocks ARM
testSuite.description: Income stability is variable, so rule 3 is not met and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: Zero horizon with ARM conditions met
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years is within 7 years, so all ARM conditions are met and the product is ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: Null credit score makes ARM condition unmet

testSuite.name: Null fixed preference with high sensitivity

testSuite.name: Null fixed preference and sensitivity yields no product
testSuite.description: Both fixed preference and rate sensitivity are null, rule 2 is unmet, and the ARM conditions are not satisfied by the given values, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: Credit score zero triggers manual review
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640, so manual review applies.

testSuite.name: Multiple manual review triggers with fixed preference
testSuite.description: Low credit score, high DTI and fixed preference all present; rule 1 applies and the result is ManualReview.

testSuite.name: Null DTI with LTV above 95 triggers manual review

          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 and application.housing.principalInterest != null then (application.housing.principalInterest + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>

testSuite.name: TC05_Dti50ExactNoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review; high rate sensitivity yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC06_Dti50_1ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI just above 50 triggers manual review, which overrides the high rate sensitivity rule.

testSuite.name: TC07_Ltv95ExactNoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review; ARM criteria fail (LTV>80, credit<720), so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC08_Ltv95_1ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV just above 95 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC09_HorizonEightNoArm
testSuite.description: Horizon of 8 years exceeds 7, ARM criteria fail, no fixed preference, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC10_VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the stable income condition; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC11_BoundariesAllInclusive
testSuite.description: LTV 80, credit 720, horizon 7 and stable income are all at inclusive boundaries; ARM 7/1 assigned.

testSuite.name: TC12_Ltv80_1NoArm
testSuite.description: LTV just above 80 fails the ARM LTV condition; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC13_Credit719NoArm
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is above manual review threshold but below ARM minimum 720; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC14_MediumSensitivityArm
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity does not trigger fixed rule; all ARM criteria met.

testSuite.name: TC15_NullPreferencesNotMet
testSuite.description: Null fixedPreference and rateSensitivity make rule 2 unmet; ARM criteria are met, so ARM 7/1 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScoreFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes manual review and ARM conditions unmet; explicit fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityLowCreditManualReview
testSuite.description: Low credit score triggers manual review, which takes priority over high rate sensitivity.

testSuite.name: TC18_AllRuleOneConditionsFail
testSuite.description: Credit, DTI and LTV all violate manual review thresholds simultaneously; manual review assigned.

testSuite.name: TC19_AllFieldsNull
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null; no rule applies and no default product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullDtiFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Null DTI makes the DTI manual review condition unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullLtvComputableFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV is null but collateral values allow DMN to derive LTV of 75; ARM criteria would then be met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 3 and 1 depend on LTV, which is null in the input but derivable in DMN from loan.amount and collateral (150000/200000 = 75%). If DMN computes LTV, ARM7/1 is expected; if null is treated as missing, the ARM condition is unmet and the result is empty [].

testSuite.name: TC22_ArmHorizonZeroBoundary
testSuite.description: Horizon of 0 years satisfies the upper bound of 7 years; ARM 7/1 assigned.

testSuite.name: TC23_NullHorizonNoArm
testSuite.description: Null horizon makes the horizon condition unmet; ARM not assigned and no fixed preference, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC24_ManualReviewAndFixedBothTrue
testSuite.description: Manual review conditions met together with explicit fixed preference; manual review wins by priority.

newExpected.ambiguityNote: The rules do not define how LTV is derived, and the ltv field is null. Using the lower of purchase price and appraised value (300000/250000 = 120%) gives LTV > 95, so rule 1 yields ManualReview. Using purchase price (300000/320000 = 93.75%) instead, rule 1 does not fire, rule 3 fails (LTV > 80), and no product applies, giving an empty result. Treating the null ltv as unmet gives the empty result as well.

Короткий горизонт і стабільний дохід, але LTV 85 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, але змінний дохід → жодне правило

Висока чутливість до ставки, fixedPreference = null → Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScore_NoManualNoProduct

testSuite.name: TC17_NullDTI_ARMAmbiguous
testSuite.description: DTI is null, so the DTI manual review condition is unmet; rule 3 does not use DTI and yields ARM7/1. DMN may instead compute DTI from income and debts.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (DTI > 50) and the null DTI value: the rules state that a condition on a null value is unmet, but the schema says DTI may be left null for DMN to compute. If DMN computes DTI above 50, the result would be ManualReview. Rule 3 result ARM7/1 assumes null DTI is treated as unmet.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullLTV_NoProductAmbiguous
testSuite.description: LTV is null, so rule 3 LTV condition is unmet and no product is assigned. DMN may instead compute LTV from loan and collateral values.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: The schema says LTV may be left null for DMN to compute from loan amount and collateral. If DMN computes LTV, the result could be ARM7/1 or ManualReview. The rules state that a null-dependent condition is unmet, which gives an empty result.

testSuite.name: TC19_CreditBelow640AndHighSensitivity_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit below 640 and high rate sensitivity both apply; manual review takes precedence.

testSuite.name: TC20_CashOutPurpose_ARMNotAffected
testSuite.description: Purpose refinance_cash_out does not affect product rules; rule 3 conditions met gives ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC21_AllNullApplication_NoProduct
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null, so no condition is met and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC22_LowSensitivityHighLTV_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Low rate sensitivity, no fixed preference, and LTV 90 fail all rules; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC23_FixedPreferenceFalse_MediumSensitivity_ARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference explicitly false and medium sensitivity do not trigger rule 2; rule 3 gives ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC24_ManualReviewOverridesARM
testSuite.description: All rule 3 conditions are met but DTI 55 triggers manual review, which has priority.

testSuite.name: TC01_ManualReview_CreditScoreBoundary639
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review applies even though fixed preference is set.

testSuite.name: TC02_Fixed30_CreditScoreBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review; explicit fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_Fixed30_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not activate manual review; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC04_ManualReview_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so manual review applies and overrides fixed preference.

testSuite.name: TC05_NoProduct_LtvExactly95

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReview_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95, so manual review applies.

testSuite.description: Fixed preference is set, but DTI 60 exceeds 50, so manual review takes precedence.

testSuite.name: TC08_Fixed30_HighRateSensitivityWithoutFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is false but rate sensitivity is high, so Fixed30 applies.

testSuite.name: TC09_ARM_BoundaryAllConditionsMet
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, stable income, LTV 80, credit score 720 meet all ARM conditions inclusively.

testSuite.name: TC10_NoProduct_HorizonAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM does not apply and no default product is assigned.

testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so ARM is not met and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC12_NoProduct_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Income is variable, so ARM condition fails and no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC13_ARM_HorizonZero
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 is within the seven-year limit, so ARM applies.

testSuite.name: TC14_NoProduct_LtvNullInArmConditions
testSuite.description: LTV is null, so the ARM condition on LTV is unmet and no product is assigned; manual review LTV condition is also unmet.

testSuite.name: TC15_Fixed30_CreditScoreNull

testSuite.name: TC16_NoProduct_CreditScoreNullArm
testSuite.description: Credit score is null so ARM credit condition is unmet; no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC17_ManualReview_OverridesHighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 triggers manual review, which takes precedence over the high rate sensitivity Fixed30 rule.

testSuite.name: TC18_Fixed30_DtiNull
testSuite.description: DTI is null so the DTI manual review condition is unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC19_NoProduct_AllOptionalNull
testSuite.description: Only id is provided; all conditions depend on null values, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC20_ARM_MaxCreditScoreLowLtv
testSuite.description: Credit score 900 and low LTV with stable income and short horizon satisfy the ARM rule.

testSuite.name: TC21_NoProduct_MediumSensitivityLongHorizon
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference do not trigger Fixed30; horizon 10 exceeds 7 so ARM fails.

testSuite.name: TC23_Fixed30_FixedPreferenceFalseSensitivityLowHorizonLong
testSuite.description: No fixed preference and low sensitivity; horizon 12 fails ARM, so no product.
